Status object (status box)

Source: R/status.R
kit_status.Rd

The result of an action. This is an S3 value object (class kit_status): its content is checked when it is built. It has an htmltools::as.tags() method, so renderUI(st) or putting it straight into tagList() renders it as a status box (the same as kit_status_ui()). print(st) prints a text version.

Usage

kit_status(
  state = "idle",
  message = "",
  warnings = character(0),
  notes = character(0),
  details = NULL,
  action = NULL,
  points = character(0),
  details_title = "原始訊息"
)

# S3 method for class 'kit_status'
as.tags(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'kit_status'
format(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'kit_status'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

state

"idle", "success", "warning", "error", or "stale".

message

The conclusion on the first line (one sentence, with numbers and units): a string or tag.

warnings

Things to watch out for (a character vector, or a list of strings and tags). Listed first.

notes

Additional notes (small gray text).

details

The raw message (R's original error text; collapsed): a string or NULL.

action

A button or link for what to do (a tag); NULL shows nothing.

points

Key results (listed after warnings; they do not turn the status into "請注意", "please note").

details_title

The collapsible title for the raw message (kitsUI uses "kits 的原文", "kits' original text").

x

A kit_status object.

...

Other content for kit_status_ui() (as.tags); not used by format and print.

Value

A kit_status object.

Details

Each of the four states has a fixed label and color:

stateLabelBackground
"success"【完成】 ("Done")mint green
"warning"【完成，但請注意】 ("Done, but please note")yellow
"error"【停下來】 ("Stopped")salmon
"stale"【要重新執行】 ("Run again")yellow

"idle" (not run yet) is not shown. kitsUI's names are also accepted: "done", "warn", "stop".

See also

kit_status_ui(), kit_done_status(), kit_error_status(), kit_stale_status()

Examples

st <- kit_status("success", "串接完成：結果共 3,389 列 × 2,058 欄。")
st
#> 【完成】 串接完成：結果共 3,389 列 × 2,058 欄。
htmltools::as.tags(st)
#> <div class="alert alert-success kit-status" role="alert">
#>   <div class="kit-status-line">
#>     <strong>【完成】</strong>
#>      
#>     串接完成：結果共 3,389 列 × 2,058 欄。
#>   </div>
#> </div>
